category_title: Students with behavioral histories who resist remedial tasks they perceive as 'meaningless' or 'stupid'
scenario_title: Independent reading with mandated prescriptive library
minimal_context: The student is participating in independent reading time in a Read 180 class using the mandated prescriptive library.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for independent reading. Please select a book from the prescriptive library and begin reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Spends a long time searching through the shelf) I can't find anything. I'm just going to keep looking.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just pick one of the books and take a seat.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: They are like tiny kid books that they make us read. Skinny little books about that big.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to choose one of them for this period.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No, I refuse to read. Dang, this class makes me feel stupid.
